title: Sharing Themes Across Projects knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which principle is most useful when applying Sharing Themes Across Projects?
options: It removes the need to understand HTML semantics, the CSS cascade or browser behavior.
It makes every interface responsive and accessible without testing.
It runs all utility classes as JavaScript in the browser.
shared tokens, utilities and component patterns should clarify rather than hide design decisions
questions.answer_key: shared tokens, utilities and component patterns should clarify rather than hide design decisions
questions.explanation: Sharing Themes Across Projects is best understood through the syllabus topics: Extracting shared theme stylesheets, Importing shared design tokens, Monorepo theme organization. Choose the technique deliberately and verify the result.

questions.prompt: Which workflow is strongest when working with sharing themes across projects?
options: Assume that starting a development server proves every page and state works.
Skip narrow-screen testing because utility-first CSS is automatically responsive.
document reusable classes and test their variants in a real component
Add classes until a screenshot looks acceptable without inspecting generated CSS.
questions.answer_key: document reusable classes and test their variants in a real component
questions.explanation: A reliable workflow checks generated CSS and the actual interface. Related topics include: Extracting shared theme stylesheets, Importing shared design tokens, Monorepo theme organization, Brand packages and shared UI libraries.

questions.prompt: Which common mistake should you avoid when applying sharing themes across projects?
options: Check keyboard states where controls are involved.
duplicating one-off values in many components increases design drift
Document intended behavior and test representative content.
Use the official documentation for version-specific behavior.
questions.answer_key: duplicating one-off values in many components increases design drift
questions.explanation: Good styling work is verified, version-aware and tested with realistic content and input methods.
